Bill.BriefDescription: Providing tax exemptions for mint growers and processors of propane or natural gas to distill mint oil.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing tax exemptions for mint growers andprocessors of propane or natural gas to distill mint oil; adding a newsection to chapter 82.04 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.08RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts derived by mint growers andprocessors engaged in the manufacturing and wholesaling of mint.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales to mintgrowers and processors of propane or natural gas used to distill mintoil. The propane or natural gas must be used exclusively to distillmint oil. (2) The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed by p. 1 SB 5862the department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse by mint growers and processors of propane or natural gas to distillmint oil. The propane or natural gas must be used exclusively todistill mint oil. (2) The exemption certificate and recordkeeping requirements ofsection 2 of this act apply to this section.
